name: Balatro

owned.what: Balatro.exe (or Balatro.love) from your copy of Balatro
owned.hint: Steam: Library > Balatro > Manage > Browse local files, then Balatro.exe (macOS: Balatro.love, inside Balatro.app/Contents/Resources). Copy it into Roms/PORTS/Games/love-mini/games/balatro/, or into App/PortStore/import/: Port Store moves it (also from Roms/PORTS/Games/Balatro/, where its earlier Balatro port kept it).

license: Commercial (LocalThunk, Playstack): the game is not included. This wrapper: MIT; PortMaster's Balatro patches: MIT; Nunito: SIL OFL 1.1
controls: gamepad: d-pad and A to pick cards, as the game's own controller support
notes: Not yet tried on love-mini: its shaders (card editions, the swirling background, CRT) are left out, so it looks flatter than on a PC.
